subject: Kickoff: MAP for Curativa pilot — goals & timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@curativa.com>, Priya Shah <priya@curativa.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP for Curativa pilot — goals & 6-week timeline

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the time last week. I'm looping in Evelyn (assigned AE lead) so we can start a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align goals, stakeholders, and a target close/pilot timeline. Quick proposal below — please confirm or correct.

High-level goals for the pilot
- Validate Redwood inference at ~100 qps with sub-200ms p50 for critical flows
- Measure end-to-end cost per 1k tokens and perf delta vs current baseline
- Capture success criteria for go/no-go decision and data retention needs

Proposed timeline (6 weeks)
1) Week 0: Kickoff + agree success criteria (this week)
2) Weeks 1–2: Model selection & integration test harness
3) Weeks 3–4: Pilot traffic + quality monitoring
4) Week 5: Review results, security/compliance checklist
5) Week 6: Decision & next steps (pilot -> paid rollout)

Stakeholders to include: Product (Champion), Platform/Infra, Security, and Procurement. Can you share the primary champion + procurement contact?

Next steps
- Liam / Priya: confirm goals & feasibility of 6-week timeline
- Evelyn: will push a MAP draft and a short kickoff invite once we agree

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@curativa.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya@curativa.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP for Curativa pilot — goals & 6-week timeline

Karthik / Evelyn —

Appreciate the clear outline. High level, the goals look right. A couple of notes from our side:
- Champion: I (Liam) will own product success and day-to-day coordination.
- Procurement: Priya Shah will lead contracts and SOW reviews.
- Security: we need SOC2 evidence and an architecture diagram for our security team review (can you surface that in week 2?).

Timing — 6 weeks is aggressive given our procurement window. Can we plan for a 7-week cadence with the decision week pushed out one week to allow for SOW review? If Redwood can prioritize the SOC2 evidence and a short security FAQ, I think we can still hit a fast pilot start.

I'll also pull in our infra lead (cc'd below in a separate invite) after you send the MAP.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neal
Head of Product, Curativa Health
